turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Mumbai? I am Rohan from the digital security department regarding your bank app.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Gupta. What is the matter? Is there some problem?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we detected a synchronization error in your account which might block your UPI transactions today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Block? But I have not done anything wrong. How can this happen?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a technical glitch, sir. I can fix it easily, but I need you to download the AnyDesk app from the Play Store so I can guide you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I do not know these apps, beta. Can you not just tell me on the phone what to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is safer if I see the screen to ensure your data is secure. Please just share the nine digit code with me once it opens.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, wait a minute. I am trying to find it. Now it is showing some numbers.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect, I have access now. To verify the account link, you must pay a nominal security deposit of nine thousand five hundred rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nine thousand five hundred? Why do I have to pay this to fix a glitch?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a refundable verification fee, Mr. Gupta. Just open your banking app and tell me the OTP you receive now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am feeling very confused. I will call my son first and ask him.
